meaning:
νέκρωσις, -εως, ἡ
(νεκρόω),
1. a putting to death.
2. a state of death, death: Rom.4:19, 2Co.4:10 (see Deiss., LAE, 94).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of…
always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
